description: DDC/CI capabilities string and VCP reads from a Sceptre K32 (EDID manufacturer SPT), read-only probe on 2026-11-04. No serial number is present in the string. Reads are current values and maxima as the panel answered GetVCPFeature; 72 (gamma) did not answer. Codes C0 and later were read in a second read-only pass. C0 (display usage time) answers although it is not advertised.
